correctness.rationale: The two complete pairwise-distinct 18-trit cycles have every transition checked by an explicit quotient update and independently by direct 32-vertex cube dynamics. The injective map sending binary vertices to their (1,2,2)-block weights exactly commutes with the excitation rule, as proved vertex by vertex, and preserves least periods for every cube dimension \(d\ge 5\). Every state in lower dimensions 1–3 is exhaustively checked; two independent full functional-graph traversals classify all 43,046,721 states of dimension four and exclude primitive periods 7 and 14. No finite experiment is extrapolated in place of the all-dimensional lift proof.

value.rationale: This determines a sharp natural minimum dimension for two nonstandard primitive temporal periods of a canonical excitable rule on the family of Boolean cubes. A period-seven orbit is structurally striking on a bipartite graph, which has no seven-edge simple cycle. The 18-site Hamming-block quotient makes the constructions geometric, parsimonious and persistent in all higher dimensions; the negative dimension-four boundary is exhaustive. The exact cutoff is an objective dynamical invariant, not an arbitrary graph slice or numerically unsupported generality.
